fake_move_patterns.description: Sharp price movement away from equilibrium that hunts stops and grabs liquidity before reversing. Also called 'Judas Swing' or 'Market Protraction'.
characteristics: Reveals Market Maker intended repricing model
Occurs at specific times (London open, NY open)
Seeks nearby liquidity before reversing direction

required: Price extends beyond previous high/low (old high or old low)
Sharp price surge (>50 ticks in <5 minutes for NQ)
Occurs during known liquidity grab windows (3:00-5:00 AM EST London, 9:30-10:00 AM EST NY)
Movement away from equilibrium price level
supporting: Low relative volume for move size

typical_occurrence: First 30 minutes of any major session

fake_move_patterns.expected_outcome: Retracement to 50%-61.8% of expansion move within 15-30 minutes

increase_confidence: Occurs at exact London/NY open times

dashboard_signal.alert_text: FAKE MOVE ALERT: Expansion Phase Detected

trading_implications.watch_for: Retracement to orderblock/equilibrium for real entry

fake_move_patterns.description: Price runs above old highs or below old lows to trigger stop losses, creating liquidity for institutional entry before reversing.
characteristics: Targets old highs (buy stops) or old lows (sell stops)
Creates liquidity pools for Market Makers
Often precedes significant move in opposite direction

required: Price penetrates old high or old low
supporting: Multiple failed attempts at level before penetration

timing.typical_occurrence: Any time, but common during session opens

fake_move_patterns.expected_outcome: Quick reversal with strong momentum in opposite direction

increase_confidence: Multiple wicks at level before penetration

pattern_matching_workflow: 1. Identify current market phase (expansion, retracement, reversal, consolidation)
2. Check for fake move patterns first (expansion, stop run, exhaustion)
3. If fake move detected, wait for confirmation and retracement
4. Look for real move setup patterns (retracement entry, iceberg stacking)
5. Validate with confirmation patterns (MTF alignment, delta/volume)
usage_notes.confidence_scoring_algorithm: Base pattern probability + confirmation modifiers + quarterly bias modifier - contra-indicators
usage_notes.dashboard_integration: Real-time pattern matching on each absorption/stops/icebergs event
